info.title: kling/kling-4.0
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "kling/kling-4.0", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: Request body for a Kling 4.0 generation. Send `prompt` for text-to-video, `contents` holding only a prompt and frame images for image-to-video, or `contents` holding any reference image, video, element or voice for omni video. Send either `prompt` or `contents`, not both; with `contents`, the prompt is a contents item of type "prompt". `settings.resolution` is required, and so is `settings.duration` unless `contents` holds a "base_video", so the request never falls back to Kling's own defaults, which are the most expensive configuration.

contents.text: The fox turns toward the camera.

contents.description: The prompt and the input media. Holding only "prompt", "first_frame", "middle_frame" and "last_frame" items selects image-to-video (a prompt and up to 10 frames); holding any "refer_image", "feature_video", "base_video", "element" or "voice" selects omni video (up to 15 inputs, with at most 10 images, 5 videos, 7 elements and 3 voices). A request with a "feature_video", a "base_video" or a video character element bills at the video-input rate.

options.description: General configuration such as watermark options. `options.callback_url` and `options.external_task_id` are not supported on Kling 4.0; Comfy Router refuses a request that sets either inside `options`. A top-level `callback_url` or `external_task_id` is not part of this schema and is removed before the request reaches Kling. An explicit null `options` is treated as absent, as the /proxy Kling 4.0 check and Kling do.

prompt.description: Text-to-video prompt. Required when `contents` is absent or empty, and refused alongside a non-empty `contents`. Up to 26,000 English characters or 11,000 non-English characters; comfy-api enforces 1 to 26,000 characters, and Kling itself refuses longer non-English text.

settings.description: Output configuration such as resolution, aspect ratio and duration.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio (width:height) of the generated frames. One of "21:9", "16:9", "9:16" or "1:1" for text-to-video (default "16:9"), those or "adaptive" for omni video (default "adaptive"). Image-to-video follows the images. An explicit null is treated as absent, as the /proxy Kling 4.0 check and Kling do.

duration.description: Video length in seconds, 3 through 30. Required unless `contents` holds a "base_video", where an edit may omit it to keep the base video's length. Such a call is held and estimated at the 30-second maximum at the requested resolution, an upper bound rather than the price, and is billed from the price Kling reports for the finished task.

resolution.description: Resolution of the generated video. One of "720p" or "1080p". Required.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description:
Comfy Router output schema for Kling's v2 task surface: the terminal `GET /tasks?task_ids={id}` document, forwarded unchanged. Every Router id on that surface is submit-and-poll (`routerresult/classification.go` records each as `ReturnModeSubmitPoll`) — and Router polls on the caller's behalf, so the body a caller receives is the finished task rather than the `data.id` handle the underlying submit answers with.
This is NOT the document the eleven Kling v1 video ids answer (`KlingVideoRouterOutput`), and the three differences are the reason it is its own component. `data` is a LIST — one element per task id the query named — rather than a single object, so the generated video's download URL is at `data[].outputs[].url`, under the element for the polled task. Router always polls ONE task (the poll route is built from the single id the submit returned, so the request is always `?task_ids=<one id>`), so that list carries one element in practice; a caller polling this route directly with several ids gets one element each and must match on `data[].id`. Second, the terminal status spells `succeeded`, where every v1 Kling route says `succeed`. Third, the outputs live under `outputs[]` rather than `task_result`.
Read the ELEMENT field, not the `outputs` container: `KlingV2Output` is `{type, id, url, watermark_url, duration, ...}`, so a one-element list carrying an id and a type and no URL is a non-empty array holding nothing playable. `data[].outputs[].watermark_url` is the same asset under Kling's hotlink-protection form and counts as a result. `mp3_url` and `wav_url` deliberately do NOT: the operation Router serves here is text-to-video, so a success carrying only audio is a shape anomaly. `routerpollstate.classifyKlingV2` draws exactly those lines.
`url` is hotlink-protected and Kling clears it after 30 days, so download it rather than storing the link.

KlingV2Output.description: A generated output. The fields present depend on `type` (video, image, audio, voice or element).

duration.description: Duration of the generated video in seconds.

group_id.description: Grouping marker, present only for grouped images.

id.description: Output ID generated by the system.

mp3_duration.description: Duration of the generated MP3 audio in seconds.

mp3_url.description: MP3 URL of the generated audio (hotlink-protected).

owned_by.description: Source of the material. "kling" denotes the official library; numbers are creator IDs.

status.description: Status of the material. One of "succeeded" or "deleted".

type.description: Output content type. One of "video", "image", "audio", "voice" or "element".

url.description: URL of the generated result (hotlink-protected). Cleared after 30 days.

wav_duration.description: Duration of the generated WAV audio in seconds.

wav_url.description: WAV URL of the generated audio (hotlink-protected).

KlingV2QueryTaskResponse.description: Response returned when querying Kling v2 tasks by ID.

request_id.description: Request ID generated by the system.

KlingV2Task.description: A single Kling v2 task record.

amount.description: Consumption amount, accurate to two decimal places.

cash_type.description: Cash account the charge was drawn from (only present when charge_type is "cash"), for example "balance". Some tasks return it; others may omit it.

charge_type.description: Consumption account type. "cash" for balance, "unit" for a resource package.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of `amount` and `list_price`, for example "USD". Some tasks return it; others may omit it.

list_price.description: List price of the task before any discount, as a decimal string. Some tasks return it; others may omit it.

package_type.description: Consumable resource bundle type (only present when charge_type is "unit"). One of "video", "image" or "audio".

create_time.description: Task creation time. Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

external_id.description: The custom task ID for this task, if any.

message.description: Task status information, displaying the failure reason when the task fails.

update_time.description: Task update time. Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

KlingV4Content.description: One item of a Kling 4.0 `contents` array. The fields present depend on `type`.

id.description: Reference ID for this input, used as @id in the prompt. Must be unique within the task. Required for "element" and "voice".

text.description: Text prompt, when type is "prompt". Up to 26,000 English characters or 11,000 non-English characters; comfy-api enforces 1 to 26,000 characters, and Kling itself refuses longer non-English text. Reference other inputs as @id.

type.description: Input type. Image-to-video accepts only "prompt", "first_frame", "middle_frame" and "last_frame", and refuses any other type. Omni video also accepts "refer_image", "feature_video" (a reference video), "base_video" (the video to edit, at most one), "element" and "voice".

url.description: Image or video URL, when type is a frame, "refer_image", "feature_video" or "base_video". Images may also be Base64. Images are .jpg, .jpeg or .png up to 30MB, at least 300px per side, with an aspect ratio between 2:5 and 5:2. Videos are .mp4 or .mov up to 300MB and 3 to 30 seconds long.

voice_id.description: Voice ID, when type is "voice". A Kling preset voice or a custom voice.

KlingV4Text2VideoOptions.description: General configuration such as watermark options. `options.callback_url` and `options.external_task_id` are not supported on Kling 4.0; Comfy Router refuses a request that sets either inside `options`. A top-level `callback_url` or `external_task_id` is not part of this schema and is removed before the request reaches Kling.

watermark_info.description: Whether to generate watermarked results simultaneously. Custom watermarks are not supported. An explicit null is treated as absent, as the /proxy Kling 4.0 check and Kling do.

enabled.description: true means generate watermarked result, false means do not generate. Default false.
